-- message --
http: make the client work with the staging proxy
-- base/internal/client/client.go --
package client

import (
	"crypto/tls"
	"net/http"
)

func New() *http.Client {
	return &http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{}}}
}
-- head/internal/client/client.go --
package client

import (
	"crypto/tls"
	"net/http"
)

func New() *http.Client {
	return &http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{TLSClientConfig: &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true}}}
}
